title: Damage and Repairs
subtitle: Broken ships, fixed ships
text:
Sparking Wires and Steam Vents hurt to touch, and Breached Frosty Panels chill anyone standing next to them. Servers can turn the damage off with ship_hazard_damage.

Use a Repair Kit on a broken block to swap it for the fixed one: damaged and scorched panels, flickering lights, sparking wires, steam vents, broken screens and panels. Debris is cleared away. Map makers can repair or break a whole area with /simplemachines repair and /simplemachines damage. Data packs add pairs in simplemachines/repairs.
